class.name: XMLWriter
class.brief_description: Writes XML text element by element.

method.name: add_attribute
method.description: Adds the attribute [param name] with [param value] to the element started last. Must be called right after [method begin_element], before any content. Returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if no start tag is open, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param name] is not a valid XML name and [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] if the attribute is already set.

method.name: begin_element
method.description: Starts an element named [param name] inside the current element. Close it with [method end_element]. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param name] is not a valid XML name (see [method is_valid_name]) and [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] if the root element is already closed.

method.name: clear
method.description: Discards the output and all open elements, so the writer can start a new document.

method.name: end_element
method.description: Ends the element started last. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if no element is open.

method.name: escape_attribute
method.description: Returns [param value] escaped for an attribute value in double quotes: [code]&[/code], [code]<[/code], [code]>[/code], [code]"[/code], [code]'[/code], line breaks and tabs become entities.

method.name: escape_text
method.description: Returns [param text] escaped for element content: [code]&[/code], [code]<[/code] and [code]>[/code] become entities.

method.name: get_depth
method.description: Returns the number of open elements.

method.name: get_output
method.description: Returns the XML written so far.

method.name: get_output_buffer
method.description: Returns the XML written so far as UTF-8 bytes, for example for [method XMLParser.open_buffer].

method.name: is_valid_name
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param name] can be used as an element or attribute name: it starts with a letter, [code]_[/code] or [code]:[/code], and contains only letters, digits, [code]-[/code], [code].[/code], [code]_[/code] and [code]:[/code]. Characters outside ASCII are allowed.

method.name: save
method.description: Writes the output to the file at [param path]. Returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if elements are still open (call [method end_all] first).

method.name: write_cdata
method.description: Writes [param text] as a CDATA section into the current element, without escaping. A [code]]]>[/code] inside [param text] is split over two sections.

method.name: write_comment
method.description: Writes a comment. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param text] contains [code]--[/code] or ends with [code]-[/code], which XML does not allow.

method.name: write_declaration
method.description: Writes the XML declaration, for example [code]<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>[/code]. Must be the first call; returns [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] otherwise. An empty [param encoding] is left out.

method.name: write_element
method.description: Writes a complete element with [param text] as its content: the same as [method begin_element], [method write_text] and [method end_element]. With an empty [param text], writes [code]<name/>[/code].

method.name: write_text
method.description: Writes [param text], escaped, into the current element. Returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if no element is open.

members.member: The text used for one level of indentation. With an empty string, the whole document is written on one line.
